title: The manuscript always at hand
description: Chapters, sketches and the author’s notes in one library. Carry on from the right place on the phone and on other devices.

blocks.text: The author needs to return to chapters, old sketches and notes without having to remember which project they are in. A single library is valuable for continuing the work, not only for storing it.

quote.text: Ulysses ranks at the top end of professional writing programs. Among it's outstanding features are the all-in-one Library. Everything you've ever written (if you like), plus everything you are currently working on or ever will work on, is available to you without having to switch projects.

blocks.text: Bring the material together through search and a link to the manuscript. The paragraph you find opens inside its chapter; on the phone you can carry on from the last place.

An old sketch and an accepted chapter should not get mixed up. Versions and export are needed before any elaborate text generation. The test: find a forgotten fragment, rework it and save it as part of a specific manuscript.
